task.user_request_original:
Execute a deterministic Transfer Matrix Method (TMM) optimization for a planar four-medium stack: Air (n=1.0), Layer 1 (SiO2 (Gao), n=1.46), Layer 2 (TiO2 (Siefke), n=2.40), Substrate (Glass, n=1.52). The optimization must vary the thickness of the SiO2 (Gao) layer and the TiO2 (Siefke) layer independently, subject to hard bounds of 40 nm to 160 nm for each. The objective function is the arithmetic mean of the power reflectance for s-polarized light at normal incidence (0 degrees), calculated at 5 nm intervals from 450 nm to 700 nm inclusive. Use a deterministic optimizer with seed 17, allowing a maximum of 64 solver evaluations. Report the best candidate's thicknesses, the full reflectance spectrum, and the calculated mean reflectance. Do not use RCWA, FDFD, or surrogate models.

Immutable original user request (overrides conflicting route proposals):
Design a planar two-layer antireflection coating on a semi-infinite glass substrate (constant refractive index 1.52, lossless), with air incidence (index 1.0). Use only lossless constant-index SiO2 (n=1.46) and TiO2 (n=2.40), one layer of each in either order. Each layer thickness must be between 40 and 160 nm. At normal incidence with s polarization, minimize the arithmetic mean power reflectance sampled from 450 to 700 nm at 5 nm spacing. A mean reflectance below 0.03 is the stated target. Use deterministic TMM only, with no RCWA, FDFD, learned surrogate or hardware. Allow at most two executed research rounds with one route and at most 64 solver evaluations per round, seed 17. After observing the actual result, choose a justified adjustment or stop. Do not claim the target was met without the spectrum and independent numeric check.
Preserve its physical constraints. Performance targets remain soft objectives.
task.normalized_request_english: Optimize a two-layer AR coating (Air | SiO2 | TiO2 | Glass) with constant indices n=1.46 and n=2.40. Vary thicknesses of both layers within [40, 160] nm to minimize mean power reflectance for s-polarized light at 0 degrees incidence over 450-700 nm (5 nm steps). Target mean reflectance < 0.03.
